Image Match

Image Match transfers selected appearance properties from a reference image to one or more source images.

Launch

labkit_ImageMatch_app

Workflow

Choose a reference, add source images, select the match method, and inspect the preview and history before export. Switching files restores that image's real persisted operations. Overlay markers do not alter the viewport.

Processing Semantics

Methods may match tone, histogram, or color-space statistics. The reference defines the target appearance but does not supply spatial content. Results depend on compatible image types and representative reference content.

Use Without The GUI

source = imread("source.png");
reference = imread("reference.png");
matched = image_match.analysisRun.applyMatch(source, reference, struct());
imwrite(matched, "matched.png");

Pipelines can be replayed with image_match.analysisRun.applyPipeline.
